newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo /Denzel to distribute in Austria.
newsitem.headline: Volvo /Denzel to distribute in Austria.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker Volvo AB on Tuesday said it had agreed a new structure to distribute cars and trucks in Austria with Denzel, starting in January 1997.

Volvo said in a statement that it will take over the importer function and integrate it into the European marketing and distribution network for cars, trucks and buses with a direct link between manufacturer and customer.
The Denzel organisation will in parallel with the existing Volvo network remain as dealers for Volvo's cars and continue with the after-sales service points for trucks.
